metaDescription: Shop custom set in sleeve golf polo shirts in bulk. Perfect for corporate events or team uniforms. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Set in sleeve construction gives golf polo shirts a more tailored, professional fit compared to raglan or drop-shoulder styles. The distinct shoulder seam provides a crisp, structured look that holds up well to embroidery on the chest or sleeve. For corporate golf outings or team uniforms, set in sleeve polos present a polished appearance while allowing full range of motion during play. Choose from moisture-wicking fabrics like polyester or cotton blends for comfort on and off the course.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve golf polo shirts with embroidered logo, moisture-wicking fabric, tailored fit for corporate events
